plan_change.decided_by: commit plan rule for owner-reported visible B2 deviations
plan_change.reason: The live comparison found a correctness defect (all-day events one day off; cause proven against the productive database, termintage byte-identical since the B1 close, so no B2 regression), a platform defect (color-mix unsupported in WebKit 17613 made selection and soft grid lines invisible) and one visible-deviation repair (cell borders). The resizable three-pane request was mechanically assessed: the contacts PaneDivider is a reusable, tested component and the takeover is small (one direction prop, two width states); the hideable-panes half does not exist in the contacts module either and stays a reported finding. Own functional commit; no amend.

planned_commits.message: feat(calendar): align the month view to the reference and add read-only day selection
planned_commits.purpose: functional: the month view aligned to the reference (neutral system surface, locale week start, day cells, event types, header, sidebar with mini month, read-only day selection into the day view), the B2 tests, the comparison matrix and the gate scaffold

planned_commits.message: fix(calendar): resolve all-day instants correctly and survive WebKit 15
planned_commits.purpose: functional repair from the owner's live comparison: (a) the one-day shift of every all-day event — mechanically traced to raw local-midnight instants in the productive database meeting a string-slice reader that assumed normalized date anchors, a legacy defect predating B2 and proven unchanged since the B1 close; (b) invisible selection and washed-out grid lines — color-mix() is unsupported by this Mac's WebKit 17613, every such token silently failed in the packed app; (c) clearly visible cell borders; (d) the small takeover of the contacts PaneDivider for resizable three-pane widths

planned_commits.message: test(calendar): finalize b2 month-parity evidence, owner matrix and handoff
planned_commits.purpose: purely determinative: gate evidence of the five phases against the fixed functional commit, the owner-decided comparison matrix, remaining deviations and the handoff

condition_per_commit: the position is self contained: it introduces no reference to an artifact a later position creates
the configuration loader binding check passes

split_justification.context_rule: If the context runs short, work stops before the commit and reports, rather than leaving finished work unsecured or committing it unverified.
split_justification.reason: B2 stays deliberately small. An owner-reported visible B2 deviation from the live comparison creates a further functional commit with a machine-readable reason here; no amend.
split_justification.separation: normative and determinative stay in separate branch commits; position 1 is functional, position 2 is determinative
